areas.designTokens: Project-owned CSS tokens; no prescribed palette, typography or visual template.
areas.navigation: Semantic links, keyboard operation, focus and accurate expanded state; routes/selectors remain in the registry.
areas.responsive: Mobile-first layout, reflow, zoom and reduced-motion support; project-specific breakpoints.
areas.forms: Replaceable transport adapter; explicit success/failure, timeout and duplicate-submit handling; QA mocks external writes.
areas.validation: Idle, invalid, submitting, success and error states; accessible errors and preserved input on failure.
areas.accessibility: Semantic HTML, labels, focus, keyboard and contrast; automated checks plus scoped manual verification.
areas.seo: Per-page language, title, description, heading and canonical/index policy; publication truth remains in the registry.
areas.socialMetadata: Consistent canonical/OG URL and explicit social image; no invented production URLs.
areas.structuredData: Project-owned JSON-LD matching visible confirmed facts; parsing is not complete semantic validation.
areas.analytics: Optional local event adapter; no collection by default, no form content/PII in events, success only after confirmed transport success.
areas.consent: Optional processing denied until valid consent; withdrawal stops processing; no replay of pre-consent events.
areas.performance: Progressive enhancement and bounded assets/JS; budgets and lab targets stay in the registry; field data stays separate.
areas.images: Dimensions/aspect ratio, appropriate alt text, responsive sources and deliberate loading priority; record licensing/source.
areas.securityPrivacy: No frontend secrets, minimal data, safe text rendering and least privilege; remote scans require a separately reviewed backend.
areas.qa: Use existing registry, runners, artifact hashes, freeze/network guards and explicit human release approval.
areas.deployment: Optional provider/build/release references only; no credentials or provisioning; export and recovery must not require LK runtime access.
